name: showreel-c3-niagara-dry

voice.text: What happened to Niagara in 1969? Frozen, drained, or moved? Lock in your guess. Drained. Engineers dammed the river with rock, and the falls ran dry. For months, crews studied and bolted the bare cliff. Turns out, they switched the whole falls back on that November.

caption:
A, B or C? Comment your letter before you watch it again 👇

In June 1969, US Army engineers built a dam of rock across the Niagara River above the American Falls, and the falls ran dry. For months, crews studied the bare rock face and bolted its cracks. That November they took the dam out, and the water came back.

Send this to the friend who'd guess frozen.
